initial:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: GitHub repository social preview, exactly 2:1 landscape, 1536x768 pixels.
Primary request: Design an exceptionally considered, quiet editorial launch card for Float Lyrics, a native macOS companion that displays synchronized Spotify and Apple Music lyrics in a small floating window or a notch.
Input images: Image 1 is the PROJECT BRAND REFERENCE, the new official app icon at docs/brand/app-icon-v2.png. Image 2 is a REAL INTERFACE PROJECT REFERENCE at docs/images/floatlyrics-window.jpg.
Reference use: faithfully preserve the distinctive graphite F symbol made from a detached top capsule and rounded F stem. Use the second image's actual lyric window as the focused product visual on the right, retaining its exact typography, three-dot menu, song title and original sample lyrics. It is a real small floating lyric window, so presenting this single window is accurate. No invented buttons or playback controls.
Style direction: Swiss editorial meets understated native Mac design. Warm paper-white #F6F5F3 background, near-black graphite #1F1F1F text, silver grays. Almost flat with only the soft natural window shadow. Clean, spacious, confident, beautifully typeset. No accent colors.
Visual thesis: the words stay beside your work; one small, real lyric window is the entire product.
Composition/framing: asymmetric 2-column composition, generous 76px safe margins. Left ~54%: a small brand mark above dominant large 'Float Lyrics' name, a slightly smaller two-line headline, and a restrained supporting line near the lower edge. Right ~40%: one actual lyric window, large enough for its main line to be legible, centered vertically with generous space; a subtle larger crop of the F mark may be used ONLY if it improves composition, but do not crowd. Product name is the primary hierarchy, tagline secondary, screenshot and support tertiary. No surrounding computer frame. Everything must remain readable at 640x320 thumbnail.
Text (verbatim, exactly these copy elements and no other marketing text):
"Float Lyrics"
"Keep the words close."
"Live lyrics for Spotify & Apple Music."
"macOS · Floating window + notch"
The real screenshot may retain only its existing text: "A little room to sing", "Float Lyrics · Preview", "Keep a melody beside you", "See what a moment can bring", and the ellipsis.
Constraints: original design; accurate product; strong contrast; safe margins; perfect spelling and punctuation. Keep the F brand geometry unchanged. No Apple/Spotify vendor logos, no download button, no version, no badges, no unsupported privacy/performance claims, no watermark.
Avoid: blue-purple neon, glowing orbs, generic dashboards, glass portals, holographic cards, decorative waveforms, tiny illegible text, multiple screens, abstract gradients.
